On another visit, Chau remarked that the Sentinelese had again acted hostile, but had also shown amusement and curiosity. items.title: [Trip Reports] 2014 Sawtooths Traverse (Grandjean to Pettit Lake)
items.content_html:
In September 2014, Chris, Peter and I did a 47 mile traverse of the Sawtooth Range in Idaho. We had a shuttle drop us off at Grandjean, and from there spent 7 days crossing the range to Pettit Lake. The weather was perfect, and since then this trek has been the benchmark for excellence for all that followed. I recently re-edited my photos from that week. Below is the route. Hopefully some of you can follow our footsteps across this land of jagged peaks and brilliant lakes.

items.title: [Atlas Obscura] Glass Wonders Gallery in Karpacz, Poland
items.content_html:
Step into a realm where sand and fire transform into pure magic at the Glass Wonders Gallery in Karpacz. Nestled in the heart of the Karkonosze Mountains, this hidden gem turns an ordinary afternoon walk into a mesmerizing journey through light and color. Forget boring, dusty display cases; this place feels alive with vibrant hues and shapes that seem to defy gravity, instantly capturing the imagination of anyone who walks through the door.

What makes this spot truly extraordinary is the sheer variety of treasures tucked away inside. Guests can marvel at the mystical glow of rare uranium glass, which looks like something straight out of a superhero movie, alongside the dizzying swirls of legendary Murano pieces from Venice. Add delicate Bohemian crystals and remarkable Polish craftsmanship to the mix, and it becomes a dazzling spectacle that turns even casual observers into passionate glass enthusiasts. It is an ideal refuge when mountain weather gets unpredictable or when feet simply need a break from hiking.

The best part of the whole experience is how welcoming and accessible it remains for everyone. Visiting costs absolutely nothing, making it one of the most delightful free surprises in town. Whether seeking artistic inspiration, looking for a unique collector piece to take home, or just wanting to admire glowing masterpieces, the gallery offers a refreshingly uplifting atmosphere. It stands as a brilliant reminder that sometimes the most unforgettable mountain adventures happen indoors.
